questions.question: What was NVIDIA's total revenue in fiscal year 2026?
How did NVIDIA's revenue change between fiscal year 2025 and fiscal year 2026?
questions.reference_answer: Revenue grew from $130,497 million to $215,938 million, about +65%

questions.question: How much did NVIDIA spend on research and development in fiscal year 2026?
What was NVIDIA's GAAP gross margin in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026?
How many employees did NVIDIA have at the end of fiscal year 2026, and how were they split between functions?
questions.reference_answer: About 42,000 employees in 38 countries: 31,000 in research and development, 11,000 in sales, marketing, operations and administration

questions.question: What revenue is NVIDIA guiding to for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027?
How much did NVIDIA invest in Anthropic, and what does the partnership involve?
questions.reference_answer: A $10 billion investment; Anthropic will train and inference on Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems

questions.question: What is the Rubin platform, and which chips make it up?
questions.reference_answer: A platform of six chips: Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6 switch, ConnectX-9 SuperNIC, BlueField-4 DPU and Spectrum-6 Ethernet switch

questions.question: What agreement did NVIDIA reach with Groq, and what precedent does the company compare it to?
questions.reference_answer: A non-licensing agreement for Groq's low-latency inference technology, plus an engineering team joining NVIDIA; compared to what the company did with Mellanox

questions.question: Is NVIDIA currently generating data center revenue in China, and what does its guidance assume?
questions.reference_answer: No revenue yet: small H200 volumes were approved by the U.S. government but nothing has been sold, and the outlook assumes no China data center compute revenue

questions.question: How large was NVIDIA's sovereign AI business in fiscal year 2026, and which countries drove it?
questions.reference_answer: Over $30 billion, more than tripled year over year, driven by customers in Canada, France, the Netherlands, Singapore and the UK

questions.question: How does NVIDIA describe its long-term opportunity in physical AI and robotics?
questions.source: Earnings call 2026, CFO remarks; 10-K 2026, Item 1, pp. 6-8
questions.reference_answer: Physical AI contributed over $6 billion of FY2026 revenue; robotaxi fleets are expected to scale from thousands of vehicles to millions over the next decade, supported by the Cosmos and Isaac GR00T models

questions.question: Why did NVIDIA acquire Mellanox, and how big has the networking business become since?
questions.source: 10-K 2026, p. 4, Item 1 Business; earnings call 2026, CFO remarks
questions.reference_answer: Mellanox was acquired in 2020 to add networking and make the platforms data-center scale; networking exceeded $31 billion of revenue in fiscal 2026, more than 10x fiscal 2021

questions.question: What does NVIDIA say about how data center power constraints shape customer purchasing decisions?
questions.reference_answer: Every data center is power constrained, so customers make critical architectural decisions on performance per watt in order to maximise AI factory revenue

questions.question: What risks does NVIDIA identify in relation to U.S. export controls and China?
questions.reference_answer: Export licences may be delayed, refused or carry burdensome conditions; China revenue may be lost entirely; and domestic Chinese competitors are gaining ground while NVIDIA is restricted

questions.question: How concentrated is NVIDIA's customer base, and why does the company flag it as a risk?
questions.reference_answer: Highly concentrated: one direct customer represented 22% of total revenue in fiscal 2026 and another 14%, so losing a single customer would materially affect results
